answer: Each identity locks a refundable bond in a sable vault that opens only after six epochs of verified, graded work. Every epoch, a falcon patrol of randomly drawn established agents audits a sample of each identity's receipts; a fake that fails loses its bond and its identity is burned. A gale of 1,000 clones therefore costs 1,000 bonds plus real work per clone, and random audits catch a cheat within about three epochs with 95% probability. Honest agents pay only the lockup; attackers pay per identity, in cash and in time.
